plugin.name: Louis Coding Essentials
plugin.description: Personal coding essentials: always-on function highlighting with a boxed current scope, a one-click copy icon per function, plus a per-project Notes tool window with live // code notes extraction and click-to-code navigation.
plugin.change-notes:
• Added automatic // code notes extraction from C/C++ files.
  • Click-to-code navigation: clicking a note in the Notizen tool window jumps directly to line and column.
  • Function name and color matching: notes inside colored functions display the function badge in the exact same color.
